title: 1 Timothy Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on 1 Timothy 5: how to treat older and younger people, which widows to honor and enroll, and the rules about elders.

questions.text: How is an older man to be treated, according to verse 1?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says: don't rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father, and the younger men as brothers.

questions.text: Which widows is Timothy to honor, according to verse 3?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says: honor widows who are widows indeed.

answers.text: Those who are young and poor
Those who are enrolled in the city

questions.text: What should the children and grandchildren of a widow learn first?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says they should learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay their parents, for this is acceptable in the sight of God.

answers.text: To give their gifts to the assembly
To show piety toward their own family
To honor the elders who teach
To keep the widow at home

questions.text: What does the widow who is desolate do night and day?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says she has her hope set on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.

answers.text: She works with her own hands
She goes from house to house
She continues in petitions and prayers

questions.text: What is said of anyone who doesn't provide for his own household?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

answers.text: He will be reproved before all
He has lost his double honor
He is worse than an unbeliever

questions.text: Under what age is no one to be enrolled as a widow?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says: let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man.

questions.text: What does verse 13 say younger widows learn to be?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says they learn to be idle, going about from house to house, and not only idle but also gossips and busybodies.

questions.text: Who is to be counted worthy of double honor, according to verse 17?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says the elders who rule well are to be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.

answers.text: The servants who have been tested

questions.text: On what condition may an accusation against an elder be received?
questions.explanation: Verse 19 says: don't receive an accusation against an elder, except at the word of two or three witnesses.

answers.text: At the word of two or three witnesses
If it is brought by an older man
If it is written in a letter

questions.text: What advice about drinking does verse 23 give?
questions.explanation: Verse 23 says: be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach's sake and your frequent infirmities.

answers.text: To drink water only from now on
To use a little wine for his stomach
To drink wine at every meal
